name: cachly-brain
description: Persistent memory for AI coding assistants over MCP. Your assistant remembers the bug you fixed, why you chose Postgres, and which earlier decision a new one contradicts — across sessions, editors, and models. Hosted in the EU, free tier available.

instance_id.title: Brain instance ID
instance_id.description: Optional. Leave it empty and cachly sets itself up on first use: an anonymous 14-day trial brain, no sign-up, nothing to copy. Set this only to point at an existing brain — the UUID is in your dashboard at https://cachly.dev.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave it empty unless you already have a key (starts with cky_). Without one, cachly creates a trial key for you on first use and stores it in ~/.cachly/credentials.json.
